prerequisites.title: Box developer account
prerequisites.detail: A free developer account or a Box enterprise account with Developer Console access is needed to create the app.

prerequisites.title: Multi-factor authentication on your Box account
prerequisites.detail: Viewing a client secret requires MFA enabled.

steps.title: Create a User app
steps.detail: In the Developer Console choose New App, then the User type, which uses OAuth 2.0. It cannot be converted to a Server app later.
steps.done_when: The app exists and its Configuration tab is open

steps.title: Choose minimal scopes
steps.detail: Draft the list of scopes the agent needs and enable only those. Add them before any authorization.
steps.done_when: Scopes saved on the Configuration tab

steps.title: Get redirect URI from Composio
steps.detail: Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard and check it is HTTPS and exact.

steps.title: Register redirect URI and copy credentials
steps.detail: Add the URI under OAuth 2.0 Redirect URI, then copy the client ID and secret from the Configuration tab.
steps.done_when: Client ID and secret in hand

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the Box auth config via Composio's API using your client ID and secret.

steps.title: Ask customer admins to enable the app
steps.detail: Submit from the Enablement tab, which emails the Primary Admin. Admins add the Client ID in the Admin Console under Platform Apps.

steps.title: Wait for customer admin
steps.detail: Box cannot speed up admin authorization.
steps.done_when: App enabled in the customer's enterprise

steps.title: Submit app for listing
steps.detail: In the Developer Console select Apps, then Submit for Approval, and fill out the form.

steps.title: Wait for partner review
steps.detail: Box's partner review decides the listing.

traps.title: A newly created enterprise can authorize up to 10,000
traps.detail: A newly created enterprise can authorize up to 10,000 custom apps.

traps.title: Refresh tokens expire after 60 days
traps.detail: Each refresh token works once, and users must re-authorize if 60 days pass without a refresh. Access tokens last 60 minutes.

traps.title: Scope tokens limited by user access
traps.detail: Calls can fail even when the user can see a file, since the token is limited to scopes you enabled.

traps.title: Free developer account auto-authorizes only your own app
traps.detail: Apps from free developer accounts are authorized automatically, but enterprise developers need an admin, so testing may not show the customer experience.

traps.title: Redirect URI must match exactly
traps.detail: With multiple URIs, omitting redirect_uri causes a redirect_uri_missing error.

traps.title: Customer API quota
traps.detail: Calls from custom apps count against the customer enterprise's monthly allowance, while Box partner integrations do not.

traps.title: Callback domain cannot be verified by you
traps.detail: Box checks redirect URIs by exact match, not domain verification. Composio's callback domain is not yours, so the callback can be routed through your own domain.

blockers.symptom: Error: unauthorized_client 'This app is not authorized by the enterprise'
blockers.what_it_means: A Server app was used before an admin authorized it.
blockers.what_to_do: Have the Box Admin authorize the app's Client ID in the Admin Console.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft the request to the admin including the Client ID.

blockers.what_it_means: Several redirect URIs are configured but the authorization URL omitted redirect_uri.
blockers.what_to_do: Include a redirect_uri that exactly matches a registered one.
blockers.agent_can_help: Check the authorization URL against the registered URIs.
